summary: Josh Lloyd goes team by team and explains where his player nicknames come from. Nearly all of it is wordplay, pop culture or Australian references, so there is very little fantasy analysis. The useful parts are a few side comments. Players who only hit threes and do little else are poor fantasy assets. He has stayed skeptical of preseason hype and of overreactions to a rookie's first week. He also mentions some roster moves: Keldon Johnson drops to ninth man in San Antonio after the Tobias Harris signing, John Collins becomes Detroit's starting power forward, and Jusuf Nurkic could start in Utah now that Walker Kessler is gone.
